name: sales_by_year
sql: select d_year, count(*) as sales from store_sales join date_dim on ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk group by d_year order by d_year

name: top_items
sql: select i_item_id, sum(ss_net_paid) as revenue from store_sales join item on ss_item_sk = i_item_sk group by i_item_id order by revenue desc limit 10
